about: Sponsor campaigns the site may show in its Sponsored slots (arkpedia-app lib/sponsors/campaigns.ts). A campaign is shown only while its status is "active", it has an https url, and the reader's clock is inside startAt..endAt (ISO instants with a timezone; endAt is exclusive; null leaves that side open). "draft" campaigns appear only in local development and preview builds. placements: "home" (a panel directly under Events on the home page), "header" (shrunk into the free space beside a page's title, on every page with one; desktop widths only), "support" (the Sponsor section of /support); the first usable campaign listed for a placement wins. image is a root-relative path in arkpedia-image-assets with its pixel width and height. To end a campaign early set its status to "ended"; no deploy is needed.
